text:
Oriana (Partnerships): Heads-up — APAC hardware broker flagged a staging hold on the inbound shipment. They say customs reclassification for ~40 units, asking for extra docs. @LogisticsBot any automated alerts?
Evan Li: saw this in the broker portal this morning, ticket BR-4829. Broker updated ETA from 2026-03-24 to 2026-04-05 pending docs.
Sanjay Kumar: that's the pilot rack (dedicated-resv-APAC-2). If it slips to 04/05 we miss the SI integration launch window. Can we pull from EU inventory instead?
Matt H.: EU pool shows 12 compatible units available but transfer + customs will still add ~7 days and higher freight. Cost delta ~15%.
Oriana (Partnerships): can broker do a partial release of, say, 8 units immediately and hold the rest in customs? Need to know if split shipments are allowed.
LogisticsBot: auto-update: BR-4829 status -> info-requested (awaiting commercial invoice). Notified @Evan Li and vendor contact.
Evan Li: vendor claims invoice was uploaded yesterday (20:12 UTC). I re-attached the PDF in the portal and emailed the broker.
Sanjay Kumar: if partial release isn't possible, propose temporary coverage via marketplace burst (ByteCloud marketplace) for the SI pilot. Who owns the marketplace credit pool?
Oriana (Partnerships): @Maya (Finance) do we have headroom in marketplace credits for a two-week burst?
Maya (Finance): we have 200k credits available on ByteCloud. Can allocate up to 50k to this pilot, pending a short forecast.
Matt H.: rough run-rate for the SI pilot at expected concurrency: ~18k credits over 14 days. 50k gives buffer for spikes.
Sanjay Kumar: good. @eng-infra we need a cold failover plan: EU hardware + marketplace burst as fallback. Also routing policy changes for the SI integration so traffic can be split by region/model variant.
Aisha (Eng Infra): noted. I'll open a CR for canary routing to EU with automatic fallback to marketplace variant. Estimated config completion: ~18 hours. Low-risk change.
Oriana (Partnerships): marketing has asked for firm ship date for the joint announcement. Tentative ship target = 2026-04-05 if broker clears; otherwise we should say "mid-April".
Maya (Finance): credit allocation approved (50k). Please send PO so we can earmark it.
Evan Li: PO sent and attached to BR-4829 in the portal. Link: https://vendor.example.com/invoices/BR-4829.pdf
Oriana (Partnerships): I'll push broker for partial release and upload HS codes for customs clearance.
OrionCloud Ops: pinged broker contact 2m ago; broker replied they're escalating with customs and specifically requested HS codes + commercial invoice.
Oriana (Partnerships): HS codes being shared here for customs: 8471.80, 8542.31.
Evan Li: added invoice link and confirmation to the broker thread.
Matt H.: if customs requests additional certificates we should expect +3-5 days. Plan B = run SI pilot with EU units + marketplace burst.
Aisha (Eng Infra): PR with canary routing config: https://git.internal/routing/PR-987. Includes automatic failover and health checks. Reviewing now.
Oriana (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — I'll update marketing and partner AMs by EOD with the mid-April contingency and confirm the partial-release ask. :thumbsup:
Sanjay Kumar: can someone tag the SI integrator to prep for mixed-region validation? @OrionCloud Ops please coordinate.
OrionCloud Ops: tagged SI integrator, they confirmed acceptance of mixed-region test harness, but asked for a contact from logistics for manifests.
Oriana (Partnerships): assigning Evan as logistics contact for SI integrator. Evan?
Evan Li: happy to. I'll share the manifest and invoice links directly.
Oriana (Partnerships): closing the loop — next updates: broker response on partial release, CR completion from Eng Infra, and marketing copy for tentative announcement.
